narrative.intro: Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C obligated $2.2B in FY2026 to date. Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C received 7 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $314M. Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C obligations were up 1111.5% year over year. Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C received most of its FY2026 to date obligations from the Department of Homeland Security, which obligated $2.2B. Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C also received $3.6M from the Department of Defense in FY2026 to date. Fiscal-year history shows obligations of $259M in FY21, $168M in FY22, $195M in FY23, $54.5M in FY24, and $181M in FY25. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date, and award-value figures in some tables are total contract values rather than current-year obligations.
